description: This file defines a web server request handler class 'ReflectionHandler' that manages HTTP GET, POST, and HEAD requests, serves static files, and handles JSON responses. It includes methods for reading request bodies, serving files, and handling CORS headers.

classes.name: ReflectionHandler
classes.description: A subclass of BaseHTTPRequestHandler that handles HTTP requests, serves static files, and provides JSON responses with optional CORS support.

methods.name: do_GET
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests by delegating to _handle_request.

methods.name: do_POST
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests by delegating to _handle_request.

methods.name: do_HEAD
methods.description: Handles HTTP HEAD requests by delegating to _handle_request.

methods.name: read_entity_body
methods.description: Reads the request body based on the Content-Length header.

methods.name: _read_entity_body_as_json
methods.description: Parses the request body as JSON.

methods.name: _handle_request
methods.description: Main request handler that serves static files or calls specific methods based on URL.

methods.name: _serve_static_file
methods.description: Serves static files from the specified directory.

methods.name: _serve_file
methods.description: Serves files with optional caching and headers only.
